item.title: Studio Behind VR’s Most Popular Golf Game Aims to Solve a Key Challenge with Golf Training Sims

item.description: Cloud Imperium Games (CIG) added experimental PC VR support to Star Citizen late last year, taking a first step in fulfilling a more than decade-old promise. Things are getting increasingly serious though after the release of its second post-VR update.
